expectation: ICOS: membrane/cytoplasmic ring on activated T cells (Tfh, Treg, activated CD4). Uncommon, a few percent of cells. Should appear as scattered single cells and denser groups in lymphoid aggregates or T-cell-rich stroma, sitting on a subset of CD3+ cells.
observed: A: discrete bright cells scattered in most ROIs, denser in aggregates; two ROIs show diffuse haze that follows tissue texture. B/C: mostly grain, plus a few cells. D: a clear membrane ring on one cell. E: ICOS clusters sit inside CD3-rich areas (white/green on magenta).
why: Discrete ICOS+ cells with membrane rings sit on a subset of CD3+ cells and cluster in T-cell-rich areas, even though two ROIs show background haze.
notes: ICOS marks scattered and clustered cells with membrane rings, inside CD3-rich regions. Two ROIs have tissue-wide haze, and fields B/C are sparse, which is expected for a rare population.
